caption: The drawing features five small, round objects arranged in a loose diamond pattern on a plain, off-white background. At the top left, there is a brown, oval-shaped object. To its right, toward the top center, there is a small round object with a light, almost white center and a faint brown outline. Centered below these two, there is a larger circular object with a detailed dark pattern, featuring an inner design surrounded by a loop of darker spots or gems. At the lower left, there is a small circular object with a bright blue center bordered by a brown edge. To the lower right, there is another circular object, darker in color, with a patterned design containing mostly brown and black tones. The objects are evenly spaced, with ample empty space on the background.
